<b>Cómo se ordena.</b> Rendimiento seman: How you are ranked. Weekly performance = what you hold now (weekly account plus what it is working on: open bets at cash-out value, rounds still being played) minus what you held when the week began, minus anything handed to you (the weekly refill, top-ups, vouchers). Wins and losses count. The accumulated account, the Store and the Exchange do not.
<b>El mínimo semanal.</b> Para seguir en: The weekly minimum. To stay in the challenge you have to bet in at least {mercados} and play at least {rondas} during the week. Miss either one when the week closes and you lose the week automatically: you take the week's punishment (in place of whoever finished last, so it can be several people) and earn no reward, whatever your result. Practice rounds do not count, a round counts once it is finished, and an account created during the week is exempt for that first week.
